source.title: Icebronze - Golem
source.author: melikovfuad7
source.notes: The package contains two native takes: idle and anima. All three combat styles use the original anima gesture with game-authored attack effects. The boss is stationary. Death uses a held native pose with game-authored crystal shatter/dissolve; no native death animation is claimed.

walk.note: Anchored boss: native idle is the stationary gait alias.

run.note: Anchored boss: native idle is the stationary gait alias.

death.note: Held native pose with Emberfall crystal shatter and dissolve; the package has no authored death take.
